name: remo
description: Remo – a modern, cross-platform controller for Daikin Wi-Fi air conditioners and air purifiers (web, Windows, Android).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @remo/core && npm run typecheck -w @remo/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build:web && npm run start -w @remo/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && npm run dist:win -w @remo/desktop
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npm run sync -w @remo/mobile
